description: Create a chart from data_refs (an array of snapshot IDs), a bounded JavaScript function, and chart_spec. Supports line, bar, area, waterfall, scatter, horizontal_bar, forecast_line, cohort_heatmap and sparkline_row. Query first and inspect rows; the transform takes one result per ref and returns flat rows. Cached values are already scaled: scale 3 means non-exempt metrics are in thousands; scale 0 means units. Percentages (75 means 75%), FTEs and other scale-exempt metrics retain their units. Do not scale again; y_scale is forced to 0. For multiple sources, inspect each scale and format; re-query same-unit series at a common scale, and use separately labelled axes for different units (line/bar/area) or separate charts. Conflicting nonempty caption scale labels are omitted; unlabelled sources leave other labels intact. Set axis unit labels explicitly.
name: eval_chart_transform
